text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, looks like the results turned 
out pretty well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the fact remains that we were just 
one step short. We need to treat this as a 
learning point and prepare for next time!”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And to share the wonders of feng shui with 
even more people☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And to share the wonders of feng shui with 
even more people☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, but this is also thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the training menu you put 
together for me, I built up real ability 
and was able to harness the power of feng 
shui in the race!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so I can achieve even 
better results from now on!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right, winning will bring more 
attention. Everyone will see just how 
amazing the power of Feng Shui is!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The future where everyone finds happiness 
stretches far ahead of us!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd love for you to think up our 
next training menu right away! I'm gonna 
work way, waaaay harder☆
